question:
What is the range of the distribution of a variable which takes the ten values:

17, 18, 27, 11, 24, 21, 34, 21, 17, 32, ?
solution:
Given:

17, 18, 27, 11, 24, 21, 34, 21, 17, 32

Concept used:

Range of a distribution = Highest value - Lowest value

Calculation:

Highest value = 34

Lowest value = 11

Range = 34 - 11 = 23

∴ The range of the distribution is 23.
